text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to accomplish. Breaking a project into milestones makes it easier to track progress and celebrate small wins along the way. Deliverables should also be clearly defined so everyone understands what needs to be produced. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. When everyone involved agrees on the goals from the start, the project runs more smoothly and avoids misunderstandings later.
